title: Introducing Stargate Norway
summary: We’re launching Stargate Norway—OpenAI’s first AI data center initiative in Europe under our OpenAI for Countries program. Stargate is OpenAI’s overarching infrastructure platform and is a critical part of our long-term vision to deliver the benefits of AI to everyone.
body: We’re launching Stargate Norway—OpenAI’s first AI data center initiative in Europe under our OpenAI for Countries program. Stargate is OpenAI’s overarching infrastructure platform and is a critical part of our long-term vision to deliver the benefits of AI to everyone.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布启动“Stargate Norway”项目，这是其“OpenAI for Countries”计划下的首个欧洲AI数据中心。Stargate作为OpenAI的综合基础设施平台，旨在支持其长期愿景，即通过大规模算力基础设施将AI的益处推广至全球。该举措反映了OpenAI在应对全球算力需求增长及本地化部署方面的战略布局，对于理解其未来模型训练与推理的物理基础设施支撑具有重要意义。

glossary.explanationZh: OpenAI的综合基础设施平台名称。
数据中心，用于存储和处理大规模计算任务的物理设施。
基础设施，指支持AI模型运行的硬件和网络环境。
